answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 29305 Country: United Kingdom Title: Can you please give me a wazifa I can read for a loved one's heart to tender. I was supposed to marry a man but he got under the wrong influence of his friends, he started to do wrong things and he said he didn't want to marry me anymore. Can you please give me a wazaif so he changes his bad ways to become a good muslimah, also he stops hanging around with his friends and his feeling grow for me just the way he felt when we first met and inshallah realises he was wrong and comes back to me and says he wants to marry me! Question: Salaam Can you please give me a wazifa I can read for a loved one's heart to tender. I was supposed to marry a man but he got under the wrong influence of his friends, he started to do wrong things and he said he didn't want to marry me anymore. Can you please give me a wazaif so he changes his bad ways to become a good muslimah, also he stops hanging around with his friends and his feeling grow for me just the way he felt when we first met and inshallah realises he was wrong and comes back to me and says he wants to marry me!! Jaza kallah Answer ID: 29305 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 230/217/B=1432) You should recite 'Ya Aziz' (يا عزيز) two hundred times after Isha salah and supplicate Almighty Allah. Note: The answer is correct. It is necessary to avoid meeting each other before marriage. (M) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
